name: Kinyen
description: Kinyen was an agriworld located in the Kinyen system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region, on a junction with the Corellian Trade Spine and the Great Gran Run. It was the original homeworld of the Gran species. Malastare , which was colonized by Gran hundreds of years before the Imperial Era, was also considered a homeworld of the Gran.
lead_paragraphs: Kinyen was an agriworld located in the Kinyen system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region, on a junction with the Corellian Trade Spine and the Great Gran Run. It was the original homeworld of the Gran species. Malastare , which was colonized by Gran hundreds of years before the Imperial Era, was also considered a homeworld of the Gran.
Kinyen was the homeworld of the Gran senators Philo and Kharrus, who represented Kinyen in the Galactic Republic Senate during the Clone Wars.
